body: I wonder if there's a way to connect to `emit_signal` directly, without the need to create a function just for it. Oh well...
What is the reason why `instantiate_property_editor()` can't handle this on its own?

I did this in a similar way to `EditorPropertyArray` and `EditorPropertyDictionary`. `EditorPropertyVariant` is similar in that it's designed to edit values ​​of different types (but only a single instance, unlike elements in an array or keys/values ​​in a dictionary).

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/54c6cfee0d4ae12d49fb79c18a37f1139dce09b2/editor/inspector/editor_properties_array_dict.cpp#L514-L520

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/54c6cfee0d4ae12d49fb79c18a37f1139dce09b2/editor/inspector/editor_properties_array_dict.cpp#L1431-L1439

I looked at the implementation of `instantiate_property_editor()` and it didn't seem like a more appropriate place to make this change.
I'm aware. Just highlighting the issue, not asking you to be the one to fix it.
